spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.desc: A mote of fire streaks at a creature: 1d10 fire damage on a ranged spell attack.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.desc: 1d8 cold damage; the target's Speed drops 10 ft for a round.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.desc: DEX save or take 1d8 radiant damage.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.desc: A mournful bell tolls: WIS save or take 1d8 necrotic damage.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.desc: A beam of crackling force: 1d10 force damage on a ranged spell attack.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.desc: CON save or take 1d12 poison damage (10 ft range).

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.desc: WIS save or take 1d4 psychic damage and disadvantage on its next attack.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.desc: Your next attack roll this turn is made with advantage.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.desc: Adds 1d4 to your next ability check.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.desc: Your club or quarterstaff attacks use your spellcasting ability and deal 1d8 damage.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.desc: A spectral hand performs simple tasks.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.desc: Create a sound or an image to distract and deceive.

spells.name: Light
spells.desc: An object sheds bright light — banishing the crypt's gloom.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.desc: Three darts of force strike unerringly: 3d4+3 force damage, no attack or save.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.desc: A sheet of flame: 3d6 fire damage, DEX save for half.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.desc: All creatures within 10 ft: CON save or 2d8 thunder damage and pushed 10 ft (half damage, no push on a save).

spells.name: Sleep
spells.desc: 5d8 HP of magical slumber — creatures fall asleep if their current HP is below the pool. No save.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.desc: WIS save or become Charmed — it cannot attack you and regards you as a friend.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.desc: Touch: restore 1d8 + spellcasting mod HP.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.desc: Bonus action: a creature within 60 ft regains 2d4 + spellcasting mod HP.

spells.name: Shield
spells.desc: +5 AC until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.desc: While unarmored, your AC becomes 13 + DEX mod for 8 hours.

spells.name: Bless
spells.desc: A blessed creature adds 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for 10 rounds.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.desc: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage for 10 rounds.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.desc: Your speed increases by 10 ft for 1 hour.

spells.name: Grease
spells.desc: Slick grease spreads within 10 ft: creatures must make a DEX save or fall Prone.

spells.name: Hex
spells.desc: Your attacks against the hexed target deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage for 1 hour.

spells.name: False Life
spells.desc: Gain 2d4+2 Temporary HP.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.desc: A flash of light: 4d6 radiant damage on a ranged spell attack.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.desc: Your weapon attacks against the marked target deal an extra 1d6 damage.
